message: A household whose goal was already sent and whose deadline has also passed gets the 'ask the MPD team to reopen it' copy, but GoalRowActions blocks reopening once the goal is sent. The notice promises a fix the admin cannot give.
dismissalDetail: this code is from the stacked #2313 (MPDX-10400) and is reviewed there, outside MPDX-10404's own change

message: The 'no questionnaire' tab test asserts right after the first update, while the status query is likely still loading, so it may pass whether or not the API returned a questionnaire.
The error check runs before the data check, so a failed cache-and-network refetch hides an already known questionnaire for non-New-Staff households (e.g. a senior staff spouse).
dismissalDetail: the error-before-data order comes from the stacked #2312 hook and this change does not touch it, and a refetch error only hides the item until the next good load

message: Flipping the switch to Closed immediately hides the questionnaire for every household in the training with no confirmation, so a stray click affects many people.
dismissalDetail: this code is from the stacked #2313 (MPDX-10400) and is reviewed there, outside MPDX-10404's own change

message: The MPD help address is plain text inside a translated string, so users must copy it by hand on a locked questionnaire where it is the only way forward.
dismissalDetail: this code is from the stacked #2313 (MPDX-10400) and is reviewed there, outside MPDX-10404's own change

message: The new NewStaffQuestionnaireStatus null mock on Wrapper is probably not reached before the ineligible-user assertions, so those tests do not prove the null-questionnaire path.
dismissalDetail: the null-questionnaire path is covered by useNsoMpdQuestionnaireHidden 'hides it when the household has none' and the tightened useNavPages test, and this test file is past CodeScene's 300-line limit

message: The replacement menu-level test does not set usStaffGroup to NewStaff, so it does not prove the New Staff Goal Calculator stays hidden for unconfirmed new staff.
For unconfirmed users the HR Tools tab can only appear after GetUser and then the status query, so it pops into the top nav late and shifts the bar.
dismissalDetail: a cosmetic late pop-in that only unconfirmed users see, since the tab stays hidden until it has an item to show, and it is not worth extra loading state here

message: The 'shows it before the user confirms their user group' test no longer waits for UserOption, so it guards a future regression less tightly.
dismissalDetail: the hook no longer reads UserOption, so waiting on it would test nothing, and the finding agrees the test is sound today

message: The hook re-reads DISABLE_NEW_REPORTS and DISABLE_NS_GOAL_CALCULATOR inline, so the kill switches now live in several hooks that can drift.
dismissalDetail: useReportsDisabled folds in the user group prompt, which the questionnaire must skip, so it reads the two flags directly with a comment saying why

message: The status query now also runs for every unconfirmed US or hybrid staff user on each nav mount, adding a round trip they did not make before.
dismissalDetail: the extra status request for unconfirmed US and hybrid staff is what lets the questionnaire show before the user group is confirmed, which is the point of MPDX-10404

message: With the user group gate removed, a failed status query now also shows the questionnaire item (and the HR Tools tab) to unconfirmed New Staff who have no open training.
dismissalDetail: showing the item to New Staff when the status query fails is the existing fail-open rule for confirmed New Staff, the group comes from HCM, and the worst case is one menu item leading to the no-open-questionnaire page

message: The Layer 1 gating text still says the tab is gated with reportsDisabled and does not mention that the questionnaire skips the user group prompt.
